Chilean Documents: Authorities and Price Bands

Every document in Chile comes from a different office. This hub lists all six with the office that issues it and the observed band, so you can pick the right page before you open a chat.

Price bands differ by document by an order of magnitude and the checks differ completely. Read the office column before the price column, because the office tells you what the document is and the price only tells you what a seller hopes to get for it.

Chilean documents: the six offices

Issuing office by document.
DocumentOfficeObserved
Passportthe Registro Civil33000–130000 CLP
Driving Licencethe Direccion de Transito municipal22000–88000 CLP
ID Cardthe Registro Civil16000–62000 CLP
Green Cardthe Servicio Nacional de Migraciones60000–215000 CLP
Visaa Chilean consulate28000–105000 CLP
Residence Permitthe Servicio Nacional de Migraciones58000–195000 CLP

Two checks specific to Chile

  • Check the identity card for the Registro Civil numbering and confirm the tax number check digit.
  • Confirm the passport shield printing and the machine-readable zone.

Local red flag

  • An identity card whose tax number check digit does not match.
